answer: A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the tundra proves it. The tundra here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Fuseebound watch scribe watch licence is the proof, because a licence watch scribes carry after scribe office audits. Nobody is waved through free: £12 in fees and a 7-day delay before the stamp dries is the price, and the wharf never covers it twice. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. The shale is on the docket.
